image: RGB, уменьшение до 1024 px по длинной стороне (PIL thumbnail)
prompt: Find every adult butterfly in the image. Give each butterfly its own tight box around the visible wings, body and antennae; if butterflies overlap, still box each one separately. Do NOT box moths, caterpillars, pupae, other insects, shadows or flowers. Output JSON only: [{"bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "label": "butterfly"}]. If there is no adult butterfly, output [].
boxes: все bbox_2d из ответа, координаты /1000, обрезка до [0,1], без порога и без NMS
